tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check packages/rehype/src/mod.ts packages/rehype/tests/*.ts packages/satteri/src/mod.ts packages/satteri/tests/*.ts packages/astro/src/mod.ts packages/astro/tests/*.ts scripts/*.ts && deno task doc
tasks.test: deno test packages/rehype/tests && deno test --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-ffi packages/satteri/tests && deno test --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-ffi packages/astro/tests
tasks.publish:check: deno task publish:check:adapters && deno task publish:check:editor-sdk
tasks.publish:check:adapters: deno publish --dry-run --check --config packages/rehype/deno.json && deno publish --dry-run --check --config packages/satteri/deno.json && deno publish --dry-run --check --config packages/astro/deno.json
tasks.npm:pack: cd npm/rehype && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../satteri && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../astro && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../.. && node scripts/npm_editor_pack_check.mjs
tasks.npm:check: deno task npm:build && deno task npm:install && deno task npm:smoke && deno task npm:pack
